verdicts.reason: A breaks the hero image: the teal circle sits apart from the can, and the body copy is placed on top of the circle. GLACIER drops below the headline, and the CTA is the same size as the two badges, so hierarchy and reading order are muddled. B keeps the can and circle together and gives the CTA a strong spot on the right, but the BACK BY DEMAND and SUMMER ONLY badges are huge and compete with the headline, and the body copy is tiny and crammed onto the same line as GLACIER.
